title: Quietly Comforting Brazilian Grape Tomatoes Stew
description: A comforting Brazilian dish featuring grape tomatoes, cooked in a clay pot with a mustardy flavor and a glassy-jelly texture, perfect for a chilly evening. This macrobiotic-friendly stew is made with wholesome ingredients and is easy to prepare.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a clay pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the halved grape tomatoes, mustard, sea salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Serve the stew in bowls and enjoy.
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing.
Reheat the stew gently over low heat before serving.
